title: Kanban board
goal: Turn the page into a kanban board with three columns, in this order: "To do", "Doing" and "Done". Each column shows its name with the number of cards in it, as "To do (N)", "Doing (N)" and "Done (N)". The server stores the columns as `Column` nodes connected to root, with a field `name: str`; they are created the first time the board is requested and never duplicated. Each card is a `Card` node with a field `title: str`, connected to the column it is in, not to root. Above the board there is a text input with the placeholder "Card title" and a button labelled "Add card", which stores a new card in To do and clears the input. Each card shows its title and three buttons: "Move TITLE right" (not shown in Done), "Move TITLE left" (not shown in To do) and "Delete TITLE". Moving a card connects it to the next or previous column on the server instead of its current one; Delete removes the card from the server. The stored board is shown when the page loads. You may remove the Ping button.
